The Subtask Name: Identify the specific YouTube 360 VR video from March 2018 narrated by the voice actor of Lord of the Rings' Gollum
Step Range: 0-3
The Oracle: Locate the correct video ID and title
Evidence: Initial failure to use API, followed by manual search refinement and identification of the candidate video "Dinosaurs in VR - Narrated by Andy Serkis (360 VR | March 2018)"

The Subtask Name: Watch the video to find the moment when dinosaurs are first shown and identify the number mentioned immediately after
Step Range: 4-5
The Oracle: Determine the number mentioned by the narrator directly after dinosaurs are first shown
Evidence: The expert watches the video, identifies the timestamp (2:30) where dinosaurs appear, and notes the narration "65 million" immediately following.

The Subtask Name: Verify the identified video, timestamp, and narration content
Step Range: 6-9
The Oracle: Confirm the accuracy of the video ID, timestamp, and the specific number mentioned
Evidence: The verification expert re-watches the video to confirm the timestamp and narration, agrees with the result, and the group terminates the conversation.

The Subtask Name: Identify the specific YouTube 360 VR video from March 2018 narrated by the voice actor of Lord of the Rings' Gollum
Agents:
- Agent: Video_Analyst_Expert
  -- Action: Attempted to use YouTube Data API to locate the video; failed due to API subscription issues.
  -- Observation: API returned error "You are not subscribed to this API."
  -- Thought: Need an alternative method to locate the video since automated API access is unavailable.
  -- Result: Proposed manual search strategy using refined keywords.
- Agent: Narration_Expert
  -- Action: Conducted manual search using keywords like "360 VR video March 2018 Andy Serkis dinosaur".
  -- Observation: Found two potential video candidates, one of which closely matched the criteria.
  -- Thought: The second video candidate seems to match the description; proceed with verification.
  -- Result: Identified "Dinosaurs in VR - Narrated by Andy Serkis (360 VR | March 2018)" as the target video.
Data_Flow:
- from_step: 1
  to_step: 2
  source_agent: Video_Analyst_Expert
  target_agent: Narration_Expert
  data_item: "Manual search strategy and refined keywords"
  data_type: "text"
  transformation: "refinement of search terms based on API failure"
  correctness: "correct"
  confidence: 0.95

The Subtask Name: Watch the video to find the moment when dinosaurs are first shown and identify the number mentioned immediately after
Agents:
- Agent: Narration_Expert
  -- Action: Watched the identified video to locate the timestamp when dinosaurs first appear.
  -- Observation: Dinosaurs were first shown around 2:30 in the video.
  -- Thought: Need to listen carefully to the narration immediately after this timestamp to identify the number mentioned.
  -- Result: Identified the number "65 million" mentioned directly after dinosaurs were shown.
Data_Flow:
- from_step: 4
  to_step: 5
  source_agent: Narration_Expert
  target_agent: Narration_Expert
  data_item: "Timestamp when dinosaurs are first shown (2:30)"
  data_type: "numeric"
  transformation: "temporal localization within video"
  correctness: "correct"
  confidence: 0.90

The Subtask Name: Verify the identified video, timestamp, and narration content
Agents:
- Agent: Verification_Expert
  -- Action: Re-watched the video to verify the video ID, timestamp, and narration content.
  -- Observation: Confirmed the video title, timestamp (2:30), and narration ("65 million").
  -- Thought: Ensure all details align with the initial findings to confirm accuracy.
  -- Result: Verified that the number "65 million" is correctly identified.
- Agent: Computer_terminal
  -- Action: Provided feedback on the absence of executable code in the last message.
  -- Observation: No code was present in the previous message.
  -- Thought: The group chat manager should allow other participants to continue or terminate the conversation.
  -- Result: Indicated readiness for further instructions or termination.
Data_Flow:
- from_step: 6
  to_step: 7
  source_agent: Verification_Expert
  target_agent: Computer_terminal
  data_item: "Verification result (video ID, timestamp, narration)"
  data_type: "text"
  transformation: "confirmation of previous findings"
  correctness: "correct"
  confidence: 0.98
